//: Story Phase 15: Brogath's ancient crew (lore only: nobody comes back), three more Brogath Rules, the captain's journal.

ancient_crew.title: The Crew of Brogath the Bashful
ancient_crew.byline: <k>From</> the Cheap-O-Rama Pocket Edition, Appendix Nine, by candlelight in the Fart-Free Zone. <k>Corrections by</> Brogath (hat colours, ledger counts).

entries.title: Ledger Billiam
entries.summary: Brogath's bookkeeper: a narrow, dry little man with two ledgers, one for money and one for atmospheric wealth, who treated every impossible thing as a bookkeeping problem. Wrote the WILL FART FOR FOOD sign.
entries.incidents: Tried to bottle the market value of the wind in a barrel; Brogath spoiled the breeze. Numbered the ship's corridors starting at forty-one. Calculated the market value of being raised up a mast.
entries.brogath: Loyal to the last ledger. Recorded every fart Brogath ever did as revenue.

entries.title: No-Nonsense Tilda
entries.summary: Stern, practical, sensible boots and a sensible (GREEN) hat. Plainly the grounded one. Took part in every catastrophically stupid plan anyway, and navigated by a compass she drew herself.
entries.incidents: Steered by a hand-drawn compass; the crew followed it the wrong way; Brogath's accidental fart turned the ship round and she called it navigation.
entries.brogath: The one who said 'No' first, and came along anyway. Brogath trusted her more than any compass.

entries.title: Old Jeb Rattleplank
entries.summary: Old even then. Rattled when he walked. Nailed up the signs that got the crew lost aboard their own ship (and took one down again, which made it worse).
entries.incidents: Put up the conflicting arrows in the Lost Inside Our Own Ship incident.
entries.brogath: Fixed whatever Brogath broke. Mostly furniture.

entries.title: Wobbly Ned
entries.summary: Guarded the anchor from anchor thieves (there were none) so devotedly that nobody could ever use the anchor.
entries.incidents: The Anchor Watch: three weeks unable to anchor anywhere.
entries.brogath: Brogath gave him the job. Brogath couldn't take it back.

entries.title: Blind-Eye Margery
entries.summary: The lookout, with a patch over one eye and a habit of turning the telescope round. Saw everything, eventually, very small.
entries.incidents: Took down the one sign that might have helped, in the Lost Inside Our Own Ship incident.
entries.brogath: Always said she'd seen it coming. Never saw anything coming.

entries.title: Half-Mast Harold
entries.summary: Told to raise the main, raised everything: the sail, the flag, the lantern, the hatch, and Ledger Billiam.
entries.incidents: Raised Ledger Billiam halfway up the mainmast; Ledger calculated the market value of being elevated.
entries.brogath: Did exactly what he was told. That was the problem.

entries.title: Captain-Sometimes Clem
entries.summary: Captain whenever Brogath didn't want to be, which was often, and vice versa. Neither of them would ever give an order first.
entries.incidents: Both deferred, both collided, both apologised, and between them steered the ship clean out of a reef.
entries.brogath: Each thought the other was in charge. Together, accidentally, they were.

entries.title: Elsie Beanwright
entries.summary: The cook. Believed nearly every problem required beans. Her breakfasts are the source of the legend of the Morning of Many Winds.
entries.incidents: The Morning of Many Winds: one breakfast, the whole crew, and a harbour that has never been the same.
entries.brogath: Fed Brogath every day of his life. The captain is particularly adamant she must never, ever be reincarnated anywhere near Garrick.

channel_listings.title: Stenchmaster Channel Listings
channel_listings.byline: <k>Kept by</> Pete, who watches the cheeks, not the screen. <k>Broadcast by</> a set that is not plugged in.

entries.title: Brogath the Bashful: The Fart-Peddling Beggar
entries.summary: The beyond-broke years. WILL FART FOR FOOD (Ledger Billiam's handwriting).

entries.title: Brogath the Bashful and the Age of Fart Commerce
entries.summary: Actually rich; then the bakery, the cobbler, the rope merchant's bucket, the farmer's shed, the forge (still lit), the boat (backwards), the Grand Gust Exchange, and the funeral. Five commercial breaks.
entries.reaction: Brogath objected to: Tilda's hat (GREEN), the number of ledgers (THREE), the shed (a QUARTER), the wreaths (THREE).

entries.title: The Top Ten Most Embarrassing Sash Flutters
entries.summary: The Gala, the Wedding (the cake), a Coronation, the Mirror, and number one: the Goat Incident.
entries.reaction: Garrick laughed. Brogath did the green one.

entries.title: The Wrath of Brogath
entries.summary: The night a bank appeared, and last Tuesday. (It knew about Tuesday.)
entries.reaction: Shown by a set with no insides.

entries.title: Brogath and the Chicken
entries.summary: Agnes of Lower Wafting, a very good chicken. The green one. A whole town, mellow for three days.
entries.reaction: 'She used to sit on my foot.'

entries.title: The Untold Stories of Brogath the Bashful
entries.summary: The cannon (a SMALL one), the wishing well (no statement yet), the chicken coop that was a bank (the hens spent it).
entries.reaction: More, after these messages. There are always messages.

entries.title: The Goat Incident (Repeat)
entries.summary: By popular demand. The goat went over. The goat left.
entries.reaction: Shown, helpfully, while the captain was trying to make Brogath do it again.

entries.title: Rule 22
entries.rule: STENCHMASTER FARTS ARE NOT SELECTABLE ON DEMAND.
entries.because: The visitors asked for 'the green one, with a hint of mango'. It isn't a menu.

entries.title: Rule 23
entries.rule: THE CAPTAIN'S RULES: NO BEARD JOINTS. NO CUTTING THE CAPTAIN'S BEARD (TO SELL, TO SMOKE, FOR ANY REASON). NO BEARD RESERVE PRODUCT LINE. NO GRAND STENCHMASTER BEARD MERCHANDISE.
entries.because: The Grand Paranoia. LEVEL SIX. Mop Brogath. (Five stars from the King. He won't stock it.)

entries.title: Rule 24
entries.rule: THE CAPTAIN'S RULES, CONTINUED: NO GRAND BANK. NO EXPERIMENTAL ANGER WAFTS. NO DELIBERATE STENCHMASTER FART TESTING. IF GARRICK STARTS FORMING COMMITTEES OR BROGATH STARTS PANICKING ABOUT SASH FLUTTER, THE CAPTAIN MAY AUTHORISE THE EMERGENCY MELLOWING SUPPLY. (GROWN-UPS ONLY.)
entries.because: The Great Mellowing, and Vindicta, and normality coming back. The one fart he actually misses.

entries.title: The Grand Currency
entries.where: The deck, where the bank was: forty lots in crates
entries.notes: Twenty thousand plastic tokens, NOT LEGAL TENDER, into a mountain of bargain-bin Skunk Weed. Mostly stems. A creative conversion. (Brogath's words. I agreed. I had to.)

entries.title: The Emergency Reserve
entries.where: Under the loose board beside my bed
entries.notes: Seven real doubloons. The cloud went UNDER THE DOOR. I'd like it noted that the purse in my pocket was not touched; only the box I was saving for an emergency. That was the emergency.

entries.title: The Visitors
entries.where: The safe corner, at the bow, in two folding chairs
entries.notes: Two grown men in a little boat called SECOND THOUGHTS, spat out by the Sharkstorm. They think I'm a hallucination. They paid me forty 'dollars', which aren't gold. They are not, under any circumstances, to be left alone with my beard.

entries.title: The Bashfulness Branch
entries.where: The old quarters, behind the barricade
entries.holder: The Grand Bank and Grand Trust
entries.notes: OPEN SO LONG AS BROGATH REMAINS BASHFUL. He's always a bit bashful. It's always open. I've been a teller AGAIN.

variants.notes: Closed. Brogath got too mellow to be bashful, and it sank into the floor like a man getting into a bath. 2.3 out of 5. CUSTOMERS FOUND TELLER HOSTILE. Six scorch marks and a dent.

entries.title: Agnes the Second
entries.notes: A small brown hen, by parachute, out of the Sharkstorm. She pecked his sash, and the whole ship went quiet for a day and a half.

variants.where: Going round, on a growling pillow
variants.notes: Vindicta's blast took her with the haze. She looked fine. She looked like she was having a nice time. I have her feather. Brogath asks about her every morning. (So do I. Not only because of the green one. Mostly not.)
